rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual term for a pedicure, especially one focused on trimming and beautifying the toenails.

example.english: I usually go to a beauty salon for a pedicure and have my toenails tidied up.
example.traditional: 我通常去美容院修腳，順便整靚啲腳甲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 heoi3 mei5 jung4 jyun2 sau1 goek3 seon6 bin6 zing2 leng3 di1 goek3 gaap3

rows.note: Use this for the broader salon treatment of the feet, including care beyond just the toenails.

example.english: The pedicure at this beauty salon is very comprehensive, including dead skin and the soles of the feet.
example.traditional: 呢間美容院嘅足部護理好全面，連死皮同腳底都會照顧。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 mei5 jung4 jyun2 ge3 zuk1 bou6 wu6 lei5 hou2 cyun4 min6 lin4 sei2 pei4 tung4 goek3 dai2 dou1 wui5 ziu3 gu3
